Payout batches require strict consistency to prevent race conditions during concurrent processing. We initially considered using Redis-based distributed locks to serialize payout batch processing.

We will use PostgreSQL serializable isolation level instead of Redis locks.

Redis locks are subject to lock expiration race conditions (e.g., if processing takes longer than the lock TTL, or if a JVM/Node pause occurs). ## Context
The operator manages stateful `ClusterShard` and `FailoverPolicy` resources.
